papers.title: Benchmarking Machine Learning for Chaotic Three-Body Dynamics in Astrophysics
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Sim2Science: ML with Imperfect Scientific Models
papers.excerpt: Machine learning (ML) and generative AI have recently made impressive progress in understanding physics.

papers.title: DarkMatterFM-Registry: A Machine-Readable Registry of Dark-Matter Models Extracted from the arXiv Literature
papers.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the Machine Learning and the Physical Sciences Workshop (ML4PS), NeurIPS 2026. Registry, schemas, and code: https://ioanazelko.github.io/darkmatterfm-registry/
papers.excerpt: To use a dark-matter model one needs to know what defines it, which observables it affects, which codes and likelihoods evaluate it, and under what assumptions a published bound applies.

papers.title: Survey of Surveys Data Release 3. Homogenised stellar parameters across nine spectroscopic surveys
papers.comment: Submitted to A&A. 20 pages, 17 figures, 5 tables
papers.excerpt: Large spectroscopic surveys have measured atmospheric parameters for millions of Milky Way stars, but differences in instruments, wavelength ranges, analysis methods, and assumptions introduce survey-dependent systematics that complicate their joint use.

papers.title: Extracting Single-Mode Rayleigh--Taylor Instability dynamics from data via SINDy
papers.excerpt: Rayleigh-Taylor instability (RTI) is of fundamental importance in fields such as inertial confinement fusion and supernova explosions, and its evolution is commonly described by potential--flow theory and buoyancy--drag models.

papers.title: Online Learning with Ordered Experts (via Two-point Feedback)
papers.excerpt: We study adversarial online learning with expert recommendations in a totally ordered action space, where the experts' recommendations may change and be reordered arbitrarily.

papers.title: MP-DualNet: A Dual-Branch Deep Learning Approach for Magnetopause Boundary Detection Using Simulated SXI Images
papers.excerpt: The Earth's magnetopause is a key boundary governing solar wind-magnetosphere coupling.

papers.title: Predicting next-week VIIRS fire detections in Bolivia: a reproducible benchmark with temporal and geographic evaluation
papers.comment: 24 pages, 4 figures, 21 tables. Code: https://github.com/Cupesi/bolivia-fire ; data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23895316
papers.excerpt: Weekly detection forecasts could help prioritize fire monitoring across Bolivia.
